common_posthoc_regularity_gate.metric_scope: Shared finite-difference metrics on author crop voxel fields, with full-crop and fixed/T00 five-lobe-union scopes; displacement magnitude additionally reported in mm.
common_posthoc_regularity_gate.unit_caveat: Diffusion and bending are voxel-coordinate finite-difference metrics, not physical-coordinate energies; Jacobian metrics are dimensionless.
